experiment.name: Checkout CTA copy test
experiment.hypothesis: Changing the checkout CTA copy from "Checkout" to "Buy now" will increase checkout completion by at least 10 percentage points within the simulated traffic window.

trafficRun.warehouseConfirmation: Flagsmith warehouse confirmed 638 total events received, read-only check 23 Nov 2026 23:34 IST

analysis.source: Flagsmith dashboard experiment 399, processed Bayesian analysis
analysis.note: Win probability is pairwise against control, not a ranking across variations.

reproducibility.explanation: Conversion outcomes are a deterministic SHA-256 hash draw per identity and variation key against the preset rate (src/experiment.mjs identityConverts). The get_it_today key drew hot: 42.2% across all 450 identities at a 0.38 preset, and 47.6% within the 145 identities Flagsmith bucketed into that variation.

label: All visitor data is synthetic demo traffic. It demonstrates the Flagsmith Experimentation pipeline end to end. It is not evidence that any CTA copy performs better with real customers.
